parts/room-6.mjs (P0 west bedroom) now places nothing: all 15 writes were refused, so the beds, dressers, lamp post and lanterns are removed and the intended layout is kept as a comment.
make.sh exits 0 and writes build.nbt, and the room line reads "0 placed" with no REFUSED or off-palette entries.
Cause: shell-west fills the whole interior (x3..4, z14..20) with air, and runParts locks air cells too, so the room cannot furnish itself without a change to shell-west.
left: The P0 west bedroom has no beds, dressers, lamp post or lanterns. The room is empty in build.nbt, and the 3-4 beds per house in elements.md are not met for P0.

Unblocking needs shell-west.mjs:16 changed so the interior is not filled with air (leave those cells unwritten), or a deliberate runParts exception for room interiors. That belongs to the shell-west owner, not this part. Once the lock allows it, restore the layout from the comment in room-6.mjs.
Off-palette: none for this part (the palette check was clean before and after).
